mapper.insert: INSERT INTO matricula (rbd, ensenanza, grado, letra, jornada, jornadaExtendida, rut, dv, fechaMatricula) VALUES (#{rbd}, #{ensenanza}, #{grado}, #{letra}, #{jornada}, #{jornadaExtendida}, #{rut}, #{dv}, #{fechaMatricula});
mapper.update: UPDATE matricula SET ensenanza = #{ensenanza}, grado = #{grado}, letra = #{letra}, jornada = #{jornada}, jornadaExtendida = #{jornadaExtendida}, rut = #{rut}, dv = #{dv}, fechaMatricula = #{fechaMatricula} WHERE rbd = #{rbd} AND rut = #{rut};
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM matricula WHERE rbd = #{rbd} AND rut = #{rut};
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM matricula WHERE rbd = #{rbd} AND rut = #{rut}
